☀️ Your money this morning, Wednesday 18 November

🇺🇸 Overnight in New York: a second day of losses. The Dow fell 1.6%, the S&P 500 1.0% and the Nasdaq 0.7%.

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 closed 0.8% lower on Tuesday.

🪙 Gold is down 1.7% at about $3,784 this morning. Brent oil is about $92.68, and the rand is about R16.97 to the dollar.

📊 Today: Stats SA releases October inflation. It's the last big number before Thursday's interest rate decision.

Prices are 15-minute delayed (06:50). Education, not financial advice.
